__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is a very old man, dressed in an old robe; but from the glint in his
clear blue eyes you can see that He is aware of the world, and wise to its
traps and pitfalls.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The old Hierophant of the holy grove is here, gathering hollies.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hierophant

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She is a very old woman, dressed in an old gown; but from the glint in her
clear blue eyes you can see that She is aware of the world, and wise to its
traps and pitfalls.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The old Hierophant of the holy grove is here, gathering ivy.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hierophant

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He looks ageless, as do all druids.  His grey beard contrasts strongly with
his lack of wrinkles.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An elder druid stands here, watching the local flora and wildlife.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elder druid

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: She looks ageless, as do all druids.  She smiles a beautiful smile at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An elder druidess stands here, watching the local fauna and feeding rabbits.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elder druidess

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This peaceful creature looks at you with big dark eyes.  Her nose twitches as
she sniffs at you, but she goes back to chewing some grass.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A doe is here, munching on grass.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle doe

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The deer looks angered at your intrusion.  He butts his head against you,
albeit ineffectively.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A deer is here, staring back at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle deer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He eyes you with contained anger.  You'd better leave him alone!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large deer stag is here, protecting his territory.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle stag deer large

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This bunny looks so adorable, you wished you had one just like this!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small bunny is here, poking from bush to bush.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bunny rabbit

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Upon careful inspection, you are sure it is NOT a cobra!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small snake slithers between the grass.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle snake

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He doesn't like you bothering him, but is too polite to ask you to leave.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A druid is here in meditation.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle druid

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: She wonders why you are staring at her, and how you got in here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A druidess is here, peering at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle druidess
